name: U.S. Export Controls: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR, 22 CFR 120-130) and Export Administration Regulations (EAR, 15 CFR 730-774)
description: ITAR (22 CFR 120-130, DDTC/State) controls defense articles, defense services, and technical data on the U.S. Munitions List; EAR (15 CFR 730-774, BIS/Commerce) controls dual-use items on the Commerce Control List. Both are current/active (ITAR Subpart C definitions restructured 2022; both amended through 2025). The agent-relevant core is the 'deemed export' rule — release of controlled technical data/technology to a foreign person, including within the U.S. — which an agent runtime can materially enforce at the data, context-isolation, and action-authorization boundary; however, item classifi
jurisdiction: United States (ITAR administered by DDTC/State; EAR administered by BIS/Commerce)
regime_version: ITAR as amended through 2025 (Subpart C definitions restructured eff. 2022-03-23); EAR as amended through 2025 (current eCFR). Verified against current eCFR 2026-06-01.
